Introduction

Woochan is a South Korean rapper under The Black Label. He is the sub rapper of the co-ed group ALLDAY PROJECT, with whom he debuted on June 23, 2025, with the single "FAMOUS".

Woochan is also known for being a part of the project boy group OG SCHOOL PROJECT, with whom he debuted on January 5, 2018, with the single "OGZ", as well as the pre-debut boy group Trainee A, which was active from 2021 until their debut was cancelled in 2022.

He made his solo debut on July 13, 2019, with the release of the digital single "ID Schoolboy Pt.1".
